items.title: Binghatti stages grand launch of Vision Iconic, the flagship tower of Mercedes-Benz Places
items.summary: The 78-storey tower holds about 1,426 one- to five-bedroom homes plus royal suites; footballer Karim Benzema signed for several units at the launch. Handover is expected in 2028.

items.title: Nakheel releases 44 beachfront villas on Palm Jebel Ali's Frond F
items.summary: Two collections of five- to seven-bedroom beachfront villas across 10 designs, sized roughly 7,500–12,500 sq ft. Phased handover of first villas from late 2026 into 2027.

items.title: Al Zorah prepares off-plan launch of 2,000-plus-home waterfront destination in Ajman
items.summary: The Ajman government–Solidere joint venture is finalising designs and permits for a mixed-use waterfront project with more than 2,000 residential units ahead of an off-plan launch.

items.title: Aldar unveils Dh6bn Yas Point waterfront destination with 1,600 branded homes
items.summary: The Yas Island project pairs about 1,600 branded residences with a five-star resort hotel, a school and retail; no handover timeline was given.

items.title: Damac launches Damac Islands 2, its seventh Dubai master community
items.summary: Offers four- and five-bedroom townhouses, five-bedroom twin villas and six-bedroom villas, with prices from AED 2.7 million.
